description.zh:
播流域名。

多个域名使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en:
The streaming domain name.

To specify multiple domain names, separate them with commas (,).
The name of the SLS Logstore to which logs are delivered in real time.
The name of the Simple Log Service (SLS) project to which logs are delivered in real time.
The region where the SLS project is located.

title.zh: 删除域名实时日志推送

descriptions.zh:
- <props="china">目前仅支持配置播流域名，如需配置上行实时日志（即配置推流域名），请[提交工单](https://workorder.console.aliyun.com/console.htm#/ticket/add?productCode=live&commonQuestionId=4545&isSmart=true&iatraceid=1608439120675-2a5c48de0b84805313c708&channel=selfservice)配置。</props><props="intl">目前仅支持配置播流域名，如需配置上行实时日志（即配置推流域名），请[提交工单](https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.12818093.nav-right.dticket.6cb216d07otFWR#/ticket/createIndex)配置。</props>

- 您可调用[DescribeLiveDomainRealtimeLogDelivery](~~2848121~~)查询Project、Logstore、Region参数信息。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为6000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
<props="china">

- Real-time log delivery can be configured only for streaming domains. To configure real-time log delivery for ingest domains, [submit a ticket](https://workorder.console.aliyun.com/console.htm#/ticket/add?productCode=live\&commonQuestionId=4545\&isSmart=true\&iatraceid=1608439120675-2a5c48de0b84805313c708\&channel=selfservice).

</props><props="intl">Real-time log delivery can be configured only for streaming domains. To configure real-time log delivery for ingest domains, [submit a ticket](https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.12818093.nav-right.dticket.6cb216d07otFWR#/ticket/createIndex).</props>

- You can call [DescribeLiveDomainRealtimeLogDelivery](~~2848121~~) to query the Project, Logstore, and Region parameters.

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 6,000 calls per minute for each user. API calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation at a reasonable rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-realtime-log-delivery --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com,example.aliyundoc.com --project project_example --logstore logstore_example --biz-region cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLiveRealtimeLogDelivery --region cn-hangzhou --Project project_example --DomainName 'example.com,example.aliyundoc.com' --Logstore logstore_example --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
